Happy Birthday, Maymay.

I’ve been thinking a lot about how much you’ve genuinely impacted my life, and I don’t think I say it enough. You came into my life as a friend, but somewhere along the way, you became the little sister I never knew I needed. A fellow shaboinger, a constant source of joy, and one of the few people whose presence alone can make things feel lighter.

I don’t think you fully understand what your birthday invitation with Willyboi did for me back then. At that point, I was so exhausted academically and mentally that everything felt heavy all the time. I was burnt out in a way that made me feel empty, disconnected, and honestly hard to recognize myself in. But that day with you guys gave me something I hadn’t felt in a while: rest. Real rest. I laughed without forcing it. I smiled without pretending. For a little while, life didn’t feel like pressure and deadlines and exhaustion anymore.

And the crazy part is, you probably did all of that without even realizing it.

That’s just the kind of person you are. You make people feel seen, included, and cared for so naturally. You carry warmth that reaches people even when they don’t say they need it. God really uses your kindness in ways you may never fully see.

Thank you for being such an amazing friend. Thank you for being someone I can genuinely call my sister in faith. Thank you for every laugh, every chaotic shaboinger moment, every conversation, every memory, and every little act of kindness that meant more to me than you’ll probably ever know.

I pray that this year of your life reminds you how deeply loved you are, not just by the people around you, but by God Himself. I hope He blesses you with peace on hard days, joy that stays, strength when life gets overwhelming, and dreams that actually come true.

You’ve been a blessing to so many people, including me.

Happy Birthday, Maymay. I’m really grateful you exist. 💛

May, you truly have inspired other students to let loose. Your friendly presence in class is very contagious IN A GOOD WAY. At first I was intimidated by you, BUT knowing how much you support other people (even my brother) and help everyone in different areas whether student council or club, is truly inspiring and helped me get the courage to befriend you too. Sometimes, I'd say that I'm impressed by how CCL4 is active and tbh that's only because it's mostly you who gave me that strong impression. (Though I recognize the CCL4 Students BUT IM BEING FR HERE) Anyways, thank you so much for befriending me! I didn't even expect that as I was very timid and everyone had their own circle. Slowly, Frem, friends, you and club helped me get out of it and your warm welcoming presence is very encouraging to others. Keep being the sunshine in the group! Also, do take care of yourself and don't overextend yourself once year 2 starts. I should learn from you to be a good motivator and inspiration to others in UCA. Man, if only we had time to know you more. Anywho, I hope you enjoyed your birthday! I'm very impressed by your vocals too. I sometimes wonder when we can sing together again another time, but that's up to you hehe. Anyways, goodnight! Happy birthday again. 🫡🎉🎉🎉

HAPPY HAPPY BIRTHDAY AGAIN LOMI. I can’t express how much I love and appreciate you, your presence, and everything about you. There’s no combination of words I could put on the back of a post card, no song that I could to describe how much I love you🥹 There’s so many things that you’ve yet to experience but with how much you’ve done and grown I’m sure that you’ll handle things, and if things get hard always pray to God, always ask for help, there’s nothing wrong in telling and asking, no matter how old you are. 

I admire you, Ate. I admire you so so so so so much—You’re an amazing person and someone I can always look up to and don’t let others make you feel otherwise. You’ve helped me with trivial things and you’ve always been there for me, when things are done and dirty, you’re there to look out for me. I’m thankful, I’m honored, and I love having you in my life. If there’s a hundred people who love you, I’m one of them, if there’s fifty? I’m one of them, if there’s 10? I’m five of them, and if there’s one person who’ll call you his/her favorite person, I’m that one person. 

In every universe, in every multiverse, in every branch, every fiber of my being, every strand of muscle, every molecule—I love you three thousand and one. No matter how far, no matter how long, you’ll always be…

My Ate, My Ate MayMay, My Sister, My Lomi.

Although we have known each other for a while, we've only gotten to "know" each other and get closer in the past year and a half. I've probably mentioned this before, but throughout the latter half of last year (and till now) I'm really thankful to have gotten to know you better, as your energy and personality has really brought so much inspiration and motivation to my life.

I very much enjoy our talks and hangouts for the vibes you bring to them, as well as discussing our shared interests. I've seen too how your radiant personality has brought together all these wonderful people around you, that I've also had the pleasure of meeting thanks to you.

My birthday wish for you is that you continue to see just how loved and treasured you are by those around you. I decided to make this site as a way to hopefully highlight that.

Once again happy happy birthday to you May 🎉🫶

PS. Thank you also kela ka Terry and ka Dean for letting this celebration happen 😁.
